values.note: Sites 7-11, 13 and 15-18 are reservable; the other 10 are first-come, booked in person only. Reservations close 4 days before arrival. Up to 16 nights in a rolling 60 days. One camping unit per site; extra vehicles paid to the host on arrival.

values.note: $22 a standard site, $24 a premium site; additional vehicle $11-12 a night. Same on recreation.gov for 2027.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/gmug/recreation/cobbett-campground-grand-valley-rd ('$22 per night per camping unit; $24 per night per premium camping unit'; 'Additional Vehicle Fee: $11-12 per night') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233936/rates (2026 and 2027 STANDARD NONELECTRIC 22, Standard Nonelectric Premium 24), read 2026-10-28

note: Grand Valley RD, Grand Mesa NF (GMUG), along the Grand Mesa Scenic Byway within walking distance of the visitor center at ~10,300 ft; dense spruce grove beside Cobbett Lake (non-motorized boats). --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov: confirmed 20 sites, 42-ft max spur, vault toilets, drinking water, $22/$24 (2026 and 2027), mixed reservable/FCFS on recreation.gov. Added the booking rules (4-day cutoff, 2-night weekend minimum, 16 nights per 60 days, reservation season June 26 - Sept 12), the site-length breakdown. Cleared the stored season close 09-12 (it was the reservation season's end; first-come nights ran to Sept 29). Lakeview confirmed: the nearest sites (1, 2, 20) sit ~30-40 m from Cobbett Lake's NE shore behind a band of spruce and the entry road. Pin 245 m from the site centroid, on the Hwy 65 turnoff. Note trimmed of field facts.
